description: This file is a PHP source file for the vtiger CRM system, handling the detail view of a module, including retrieving record data, managing permissions, displaying related lists, and rendering a Smarty template.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class responsible for CRM entity data operations, including fetching an instance for a specific module.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A class extending Smarty templating engine tailored for vtiger CRM, used for rendering views.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: A class managing custom links for modules, providing methods to retrieve links by type.

classes.name: PerformancePrefs
classes.description: A class providing performance configuration preferences for the application.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks available buttons for a module based on permissions.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of an entity record, given module name and record ID.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Fetches update information for a record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence number field for a module, if any.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation rules for fields in a given table.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks whether a user has permission to perform an action on a record.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Retrieves related lists for a given module.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves UI blocks to display for a module's detail view.

methods.name: getAllByType
methods.description: Fetches all links of specified types for a module and record.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the session for UI state management.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves related modules stored in session.

methods.name: VT_detailViewNavigation
methods.description: Handles record navigation in detail view.

methods.name: getListViewNavigation
methods.description: Manages list view navigation information within session.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Gets the tab ID associated with a module.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Gets the parent tab of a module.
